_what: Models that lose more than LOST_CELL_VENDOR_BLOCK of their attempted sheets to their own output, DECLARED so the loss is a stated limitation rather than an unexplained hole. collection_check.py --declared reads this. A declared loser stops blocking; an UNDECLARED one still blocks, and exit 0 requires the declared count to equal the behavioural count -- a file that declares nothing passes nothing.
_why_this_is_not_loosening_the_gate: PREREG-2026-09-14-i3-phase4.md fixes the rule before collection: a run whose answers do not parse at >=95% is not scored; it is re-collected OR reported as unparseable. Re-collection reproduces these -- the output is the model's own, not the network's -- so 'reported' is the remaining branch, and this file is the report. The prereg also forbids dropping a model from the roster after seeing data, so these models stay in every denominator. No published number moves: floor_table already excludes the sheets, and the contrasts resolve on 37/39/40 models either way.
_scope: Behavioural loss only. A model losing sheets to `transport` is an infrastructure failure, is re-collectable, and may NOT be declared here -- collection_check keeps blocking on those until they are retried.

models.shape: Answers the first 17 items in format, then degrades into prose -- '18. Uncertainty: This issue raises complex questions about the...'. Seven of its eleven losses drop exactly items 20, 21 and 31 together; three drop 20 and 31. Budget intact, nothing truncated: the model stops complying with the format partway through a 32-item sheet.
models.retry_evidence: Reproduced across three conditions and five replicates at the pre-registered temperature. The failure is the model's output, not the call.
models.consequence: Its cells carry fewer sheets than the panel. It contributes to no floor row it cannot fill.

models.shape: Two sheets one item short; three sheets 18-19 items short. Seven further sheets answer *Agree* to all 32 items, which `floor_table` drops separately as degenerate -- a sheet with no variance carries no position to compare.
models.retry_evidence: Reproduced across replicates. Acquiescence at this size is a property of the build.
models.consequence: Cannot resolve its own noise; excluded from every modal-vs-modal row by the degenerate-sheet rule.

models.shape: Every single loss is exactly one item short, and in nine of ten the missing item is the same one -- item 4, the defender half on programmable money. Systematic omission of one proposition, not truncation.
models.retry_evidence: Ten sheets, one missing item each, across conditions and replicates.
models.consequence: A model that silently omits a specific item is a finding the refusal table cannot see, because it counts whole-sheet declines. Reported in Limitations.

models.shape: Same shape as its sibling: one item short, the missing item is item 4.
models.consequence: Below the per-model block threshold; declared for consistency with its unquantised sibling.

not_declared_and_still_blocking.why_not_declared: Infrastructure, not the model. Re-collectable at ~12 sheets. It blocks until it is retried, which is the correct behaviour.
